description_en: Detaches tags from VPC peering connections
description_zh: 调用UnTagResources接口为指定的VPC对等连接统一解绑标签
kebab_example: aliyun vpcpeer un-tag-resources --resource-id pcc-bp16qjewdsunr41m10000 --resource-type PeerConnection --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: UnTagResources

parameters.help_en: The resource ID. You can specify up to 20 resource IDs
parameters.help_zh: 资源ID。最多支持解绑20个资源ID
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The key of the tag to detach. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. An empty string is supported.

The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
要解绑的标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。如需传入该值，可以输入空字符串。


最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
parameters.name: tag_key

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to detach all tags from the resource. Valid values:

true: Detaches all tags from the resource.

false (default): Does not detach all tags from the resource
parameters.help_zh:
是否解绑资源的所有标签。取值：
true：解除资源的所有标签。
false（默认值）：不解除资源的所有标签
parameters.name: all

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Set the value to PeerConnection, which specifies a VPC peering connection
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型。取值：PeerConnection，VPC对等连接
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
A client token to ensure that the request is idempotent.

Generate a unique token from your client for each request. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the resource is located.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html
parameters.help_zh:
标签所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the tags were detached. Valid values:

true: The tags were detached.

false: The tags failed to be detached
Success.description_zh:
是否解绑成功。取值：

true：创建并绑定成功。
false：创建并绑定失败
